name: Rath
abilities: Enhanced strength (dismembered a Forever Knight tank and tossed the pieces)
Anger empowerment - strength rises with rage
Retractable wrist claws (cut through a Plumber ship hull, Attea's blaster)
Extreme durability (point-blank blasts, several-hundred-foot falls, crushed by Way Big's hand)
Enhanced agility, jumping, wall-running and quadrupedal speed
Limited space survivability; heat and acid resistance
weaknesses: Hardwired aggression and low intelligence - easily distracted, argues with inanimate objects, terrible at diplomacy
Afraid of water like a housecat
Controlled by cat-controllers (Nyancy Chan) and distracted by laser pointers
Sensitive hearing hurt by sonic attacks
summary: An orange wrestling tiger with one claw per wrist who talks in third person, yells at gravity, and gets stronger the angrier he gets.
traits: Naked until Skurd gave him a luchador outfit (The Secret of Dos Santos)
notableFeats: Stayed transformed for most of a diplomatic mission escorting the Prince of Lewoda (Con of Rath)
Defeated Manny with wrestling moves (Above and Beyond)
Tore apart the Forever Knights' Plasma Beam Tank (Duped)
Crashed a stolen Plumber ship by ripping it apart mid-flight (Prisoner Number 775 is Missing)
Saved reporter Diane Farrah and later fought Alpha (Ben 10/Generator Rex: Heroes United)
Fought Mad Way Big alongside Lightning Volt (It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 2)

appearances.designNotes: Orange-and-white bipedal tiger, no tail, black stripes, one black claw per wrist, green eyes; recalibrated Omnitrix symbol centred on chest.
Same design as Alien Force with the Ultimatrix symbol on chest. Heroes United added tufts of fur on arms/legs/chin and bulging veins.

notableEpisodes: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad Ben World: Part 2
appearances.designNotes: OV1 (intro and It Was Them only): UAF look but more muscular, longer pointed eyebrows, darker fur. OV2 (rest of OV, the standard design): black eyebrows, yellowish teeth, Omnitrix on chest - used for card art. OV3 (The Secret of Dos Santos onward): green/black luchador outfit with mask, gloves, boots, silver claws and the Omnitrix on the belt.

image.label: OV2
image.notes: infobox OV2 (standard, pre-luchador) render; OV1 = 'Rath ov1 no bg.png', OV3 luchador = 'Rath luchador official.png'

scoring.rationale: Brute force and toughness: dismembers tanks bare-handed, survives point-blank blasts and being crushed by Way Big, and gets stronger as he rages. Zero range, zero subtlety, feral intellect (2); his temper makes him hard for Ben to aim (controlPenalty 2) and he is scared of water and cat-whisperers.

notes: OV has three designs; OV2 'pre-mask' is the standard design used for most of OV and chosen for card art per brief. Luchador (OV3) appears only from The Secret of Dos Santos.
All AF uses are in wiki AF Season 2 (16-year-old Ben).
Also used by Azmuth (Primus), Albedo (Negative Rath in AF/UA/OV), Gwen (Inspector 13) and Mad Ben (Mad Rath, And Then There Were None) - none add appearances.
Ultimate Rath exists but was only ever used by Albedo (OV); ultimateFormId still set.
Heroes United (UA-era) transformations folded into UA appearance.
